title: •Let’s Keep A Little Optimism Here
caption: •Let’s Keep A Little Optimism Here (V)
game_text: Deploy on your non-droid character present at a battleground site; character may not leave here or move. Target a Dark Jedi at a site. You lose no more than 1 Force to Force drains at target’s location. This Utinni Effect canceled when reached by target.
lore: The heroes of the Rebellion know that where there is life, there is hope.

notes: Unique. Banner UTINNI EFFECT (printed base is a Death Star II Effect). The sheet notes errata to card #8 on 25 June 2007; the sheet text is final and transcribed as printed (matches the stub). Curly apostrophes in Let’s and target’s. A small brown sphere is printed in the middle of the bottom strip between the caption and the number (sheet artifact, as on earlier sets; not transcribed). Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line Death Star II SE-style (2000). Modern: VB3-L-letskeepalittleoptimismhere-pre.gif (350 px) used; VSh-L-letskeepalittleoptimismhere-pre.gif (350, PC Virtual Shields version) also downloaded to modern/; Ref3-L-… (Reflections III reprint) and VSh '…herev' variants exist, not downloaded.
